children: Bluejay Diagnostics entered a Distribution, Co-Marketing & Strategic Partnership Agreement with Lovell Government Services to expand sales of its diagnostic products to U.S. federal, state, and local agencies following required regulatory clearance. The deal grants Lovell exclusive rights for SDVOSB set-aside procurements across VA, DoD, and IHS channels, and non-exclusive rights for open-market government purchases. Lovell will receive an approximate 15% distribution fee on catalog sales and a 2% fee for DAPA prime vendor sales, with catalog prices fixed for at least 12 months. The agreement runs for two years with automatic annual renewals and includes a co-marketing program to build stakeholder awareness.
: Expand federal sales channels and awareness via SDVOSB partner
